title: Identification of input variables
statement: Let $n,m$ be natural numbers, let $\pi:\{0,\ldots,n-1\}\to\{0,\ldots,m-1\}$ be a map, and let $f$ map sign vectors of length $n$ to the units of $\mathbb Z$. Define a function on sign vectors $w$ of length $m$ by $w\mapsto f\bigl((w_{\pi(i)})_{i=0}^{n-1}\bigr)$; that is, each input coordinate $i$ of $f$ is assigned the coordinate selected by $\pi(i)$.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ maps indices from $0$ through $n-1$ to indices from $0$ through $m-1$
$f$ maps sign vectors of length $n$ to units of $\mathbb Z$
